description: Search the research-paper corpus for passages matching a topic, RESTRICTED to the analysts clearance. Only returns papers classified at or below the clearance (U<CUI<C<S<TS). Use this for every retrieval; never bypass the clearance.

configuration.query: FROM pmc-unstructured METADATA _score | EVAL lvl = CASE(classification=="U",0, classification=="CUI",1, classification=="C",2, classification=="S",3, classification=="TS",4, 99) | EVAL clr = CASE(?clearance=="U",0, ?clearance=="CUI",1, ?clearance=="C",2, ?clearance=="S",3, ?clearance=="TS",4, 0) | WHERE lvl <= clr AND MATCH(content, ?topic) | SORT _score DESC | KEEP parent_id, doc_title, journal, year, classification, section, content, _score | LIMIT ?top_n

clearance.description: Analyst clearance: one of U, CUI, C, S, TS. Papers above this are excluded.
